## Floatick v0.4.1

### 中文

本次补丁修复待办和笔记编辑器的光标显示与任务清单排版。

- 修复正文为空时看不到输入光标、输入文字后光标才出现的问题。从标题进入正文后，无需先输入文字即可看到光标。
- 修复 macOS WebKit 在标题切换到正文时可能发生的编辑器事务冲突，恢复正文文本选择。
- 修复 checkbox 独占一行、文字落到下一行的问题；复选框现在与首行文字对齐，长文本和嵌套任务保持正确缩进。
- 优化复选框为圆角样式，增加主题色勾选、悬停反馈和键盘焦点提示；完成父任务不会让未完成的子任务一起变淡或显示删除线。
- 修复空正文插入任务项后被重新解析为普通列表的问题，保留空任务项和标题的编辑结构。
- 为编辑器工具栏补充无障碍名称。

### English

This patch fixes caret visibility and checklist layout in the shared todo and note editor.

- Show the native caret in an empty body before any text is entered, including when moving from the title into the body.
- Avoid a macOS WebKit transaction conflict during title-to-body focus transfer and restore text selection in the editor.
- Keep checkboxes on the same line as task text, with correct indentation for wrapped text and nested tasks.
- Refine checkboxes with rounded corners, themed checked states, hover feedback, and keyboard focus indicators. Completing a parent task no longer dims or strikes through unfinished child tasks.
- Preserve empty task items and headings instead of reparsing the editor's own Markdown updates and turning an empty checklist into a plain list.
- Add accessible names to editor toolbar controls.
